{"outcome":"DIRECT_HIGH_QUALITY","best_model_id":"PGS001320","confidence":"Moderate","rationale":"Multiple direct-match hypertension candidates are present (e.g., PGS000706, PGS001320, PGS001838, PGS002047, PGS002296, PGS004234, PGS004236, PGS004934, plus others). {"outcome":"DIRECT_HIGH_QUALITY","best_model_id":"PGS001320","confidence":"Moderate","rationale":"Multiple direct-match hypertension PRS candidates are present (e.g., PGS000706, PGS001320, PGS001838, PGS002047, PGS002335/2407/2456/2505/2554/2603/2652/2701, PGS002765, PGS002777/2778, PGS002994–PGS003028, PGS004191–PGS004194, PGS004234/4236, PGS004455/4525, PGS004785/4787, PGS004934, PGS005144/5153). Limitation: PGS001320 originates from a pan-trait UK Biobank sparse-score framework (PLoS Genet “813 traits”), which domain knowledge flags as often underperforming disease-focused models; however, within this context it remains the best-supported direct-match due to having the clearest PRS-only metrics with clean covariate specification and coherent endpoint alignment."}

{"outcome":"DIRECT_HIGH_QUALITY","best_model_id":"PGS004236","confidence":"Moderate","rationale":"There are multiple direct-match hypertension candidates in the context (e.g., PGS001320, PGS002047, PGS004191/192/193/194, PGS004234, PGS004236). PGS004236 is selected because it is explicitly hypertension (trait_efo=hypertension; phenotyping_reported=prevalent hypertension), uses a multi-score aggregation-style method (PRSsum) which is a positive structural signal per domain guidance (multi-score aggregation tends to outperform single-score construction), and reports strong effect-size evidence (OR=2.1, 95% CI 1.99–2.21) with supportive full-model discrimination (AUROC=0.764, CI 0.751–0.777). Competing direct matches include UKB pan-trait/framework models (e.g., PGS001320; PGS002047/PGS001838 from the 'Portability of 245 polygenic scores' framework), which domain guidance warns can underperform disease-focused/multi-cohort models; and single-score UKB LASSO models (PGS004191–PGS004194) with only EUR evaluation and no PRS-only metrics. Main limitation: PGS004236’s reported AUROC is full-model (and no explicit PRS-only AUROC/R2 is provided), and the endpoint is prevalent rather than incident; these reduce certainty when comparing against other direct-match candidates with PRS-only metrics (e.g., PGS001320 reports PGS-only AUROC/R2)."}

{"outcome":"DIRECT_HIGH_QUALITY","best_model_id":"PGS004236","confidence":"Moderate","rationale":"Multiple direct-match hypertension candidates are present (e.g., PGS001320, PGS001838, PGS002047, PGS004234, PGS004236, PGS004934). {"outcome":"DIRECT_HIGH_QUALITY","best_model_id":"PGS000007","confidence":"Moderate","rationale":"Direct-match candidates for breast carcinoma are present in large numbers, including multiple coherent disease-focused breast cancer PRS from Am J Hum Genet (Mavaddatt et al.). {"outcome":"DIRECT_SUB_OPTIMAL","best_model_id":"PGS001135","confidence":"Moderate","rationale":"Direct-match models for the exact target concept (arthritis) are present, notably PGS001135 (trait_reported/trait_efo/phenotyping_reported all: “Arthritis (nos)” / “arthritis”).
